texts.name: yogas
lines: Yoga                Varga Yoga givers                     Results ascribed to yoga                                               Brief definition of yoga
Malavya             D-1   Ve                              Enjoys luxuries, happy                                                 Venus in a kendra in moolatrikona or own or exaltation sign
Vesi                D-1   Ma, Me, Ve                      Balanced, truthful and happy                                           Planets other than Moon in 2nd from Sun
Gaja-Kesari         D-1   Mo, Ju                          Famous and virtuous                                                    Moon and Jupiter in mutual kendras
Maalaa              D-1   Naabhasa yoga - throughout life Happy, comforts and luxuries                                           Benefics in 3 kendras
Paasa               D-1   Naabhasa yoga - throughout life Talkative, characterless, may be imprisoned                            Seven planets in 5 rasis
Asubha              D-1   Su, Sa                          Desirous, sinful and enjoying the wealth of others                     Malefics in 2nd and 12th houses
Guru-Mangala        D-1   Ju, Ma                          Righteous and energetic                                                Jupiter and Mars together or in samasaptaka
Parvata             D-1   Mo, Me, Ju, Ve                  Fortunate, charitable, eloquent, easy-going, famous                    kendras have benefics, 7th and 8th have no malefics
Chaamara            D-1   Mo, Ju                          Long-lived, scholarly, eloquent, learned in many arts                  Two benefics in 7th, 9th and 10th
Bheri               D-1   Su, Ma, Me, Ju, Ve, Sa          Wealth, good spouse and children, fame, character, virtuous, religious Strong 9th lord and planets in 1st, 2nd, 7th and 12th houses
Mridanga            D-1   Mo, Ve                          King or an equal and happy                                             Planets in own/exaltation sign in kendras/konas and strong lagna lord

Kalpadruma/Parijata D-1   Ve, Ve, Ve, Ve                  King, principled, warrior, prosperous, strong, kind                    Lagna lord, his disposior, latter's rasi & navamsa dispositors are all in own/exaltation sign or kendra/kona

Saraswati           D-1   Me, Ju, Ve                      Very learned, skillful, intelligent, famous, praised                   Mercury, Jupiter and Venus in kendras/konas/2nd, Jupiter in own/exaltation/friendly sign
Raja/Lakshmi        D-1   Ve, Me                          Fortunate and high achiever                                            Conjunction, aspect or exchange of 1st/9th lords
Rajayoga            D-1   Ma, Me                          Successful and high achievements                                       Conjunction, aspect or exchange of kendra/kona lords
Yogakaraka          D-1   Sa                              Success and achievements                                               Same planet owns a kendra and a kona
Rajayoga            D-1   Ma, Ve                          Successful and high achievements                                       Conjunction, aspect or exchange of kendra/kona lords
Yogada (HL)         D-1   Ma                              Wealth and prosperity                                                  Associated with lagna and HL (by aspect, conjunction or ownership)
Yogada (HL)         D-1   Me                              Wealth and prosperity                                                  Associated with lagna and HL (by aspect, conjunction or ownership)
Yogada (HL)         D-1   Ve                              Wealth and prosperity                                                  Associated with lagna and HL (by aspect, conjunction or ownership)
Rajayoga            D-1   Ju, Me                          Successful and high achivements                                        Atma karaka and 9th lord in lagna, 5th or 7th
Viparita Raja Yoga  D-1   Ju, Ve, Me                      Success after pressures or someone else's losses                       The 6th, 8th and 12th lords in conjunction or samasaptaka
Raja Sambandha      D-1   Mo, Mo                          Important person in a king's court                                     Amatya karaka conjoining/aspecting 10th lord
Raja Sambandha      D-1   Mo                              An intelligent minister                                                Amatya karaka in own sign or exaltation sign
Raja Sambandha      D-1   Ju, Mo                          An associate liked by a king                                           Amatya karaka in a kendra/kona from atma karaka
Parivraja/Pravrajya D-1   Mo                              An ascetic (Moon shows a pilgrim or a Saiva)                           Moon's dispositor aspected only by Saturn
